about.heroTitle: Meet <brand>Life Store</brand> — an Eco-friendly Lifestyle for Your Everyday Life
about.heroQuote: We believe a healthy environment starts at home.
about.heroText: In today's rapidly evolving world, where plastic consumption has reached a critical point, caring for our health and the environment is the responsibility of each of us. <bold>Life Store</bold> was created to offer <bold>safe, long-lasting and aesthetic alternatives</bold> to plastic tableware and household items. Our goal is to make eco-friendly living accessible and comfortable for everyone.
about.missionTitle: Our Mission: Safe Alternatives for Everyday Life
about.missionText: Our goal is simple — to help you reduce plastic use without having to give up comfort. Every item at Life Store is carefully selected to make your dining routine healthier and your home environment much safer.
about.trustSubtitle: There are countless options online, but for us quality and safety come first. Every product goes through rigorous selection.
about.card1Desc: Our lunchboxes and containers are made from the highest standard SUS 304 stainless steel and tempered glass, which contain no harmful BPA.
about.card2Desc: Storage boxes and accessories are made from 100% natural, renewable bamboo, which adds a distinctive warmth to bathrooms and kitchens.
about.card3Desc: Every item is chosen to be maximally practical — easy to carry at the office, school, or while travelling.
about.ctaText: We believe great changes begin with <bold>small, everyday choices</bold>. Life Store is your reliable partner on this path. Join our eco-friendly family and transform your daily life for the better.

terms.s2Text: Visual materials, product descriptions and logos on the website are the intellectual property of {{siteName}}.
terms.s3Intro: We offer a flexible payment system:
terms.s3OnDeliveryText: Cash or card payment to the courier.

terms.s6Text: {{siteName}} is not liable for damages caused by improper use of products.
terms.s7Text: These terms are governed by Georgian law. Disputes shall be resolved through mutual negotiation or in a Georgian court.

refundPolicy.bannerTitle: Return and Refund Terms and Procedures
refundPolicy.bannerText: This document governs the conditions for returning products and receiving refunds for purchases made in {{siteName}}'s online store. Please read the following terms carefully before placing an order.
refundPolicy.s1Intro1: Our goal is maximum customer satisfaction. In accordance with Georgian legislation, you have the right to request the return or exchange of a purchased item within
refundPolicy.condition1: The item must be unused and in its original condition.
refundPolicy.condition2: The commercial appearance, label and packaging must be intact.
refundPolicy.condition3: Proof of payment must be presented (invoice).
refundPolicy.ex1: The item has been damaged by the customer due to improper use.
refundPolicy.ex2: The legally mandated 14-day period has expired.
refundPolicy.ex3: The item falls under the hygiene or perishable category (except for factory defects).
refundPolicy.ex4Bold: Items that come into contact with food
refundPolicy.ex4Rest: (lunchboxes, thermoses, dishes, salt shakers) if signs of use are visible (odour, residue, wash marks).
refundPolicy.ex5: Decorative and seasonal items (if signs of use are visible).
refundPolicy.ex6: Products made to individual order or custom cut.
refundPolicy.procedureIntro: Once the return is confirmed, the refund will be credited to the same bank account from which the payment was made.
refundPolicy.shippingNote: * Original shipping costs are non-refundable in case of return.

privacyPolicy.bannerText: Welcome to {{siteName}}. This document explains how we process only the information necessary to fulfil your order.
privacyPolicy.s1Intro: To provide our services, we only need the data required to deliver your item:
privacyPolicy.s1ContactText: Name, surname, phone number (for the courier).
privacyPolicy.s1DeliveryText: Physical address where you wish to receive the parcel.
privacyPolicy.s1HistoryText: Information about the items you have purchased.
privacyPolicy.s2Intro: Your data is used only for:
privacyPolicy.s2Li1: Processing your order and preparing invoices.
privacyPolicy.s2Li2: Providing the address to the courier.
privacyPolicy.s2Li3: Contacting you if a question arises regarding your order.
privacyPolicy.s3Intro: We do not sell or make your data public. Information is shared only with:
privacyPolicy.s3CourierText: Only name, address and phone number (for parcel delivery).
privacyPolicy.s3GovText: Only in exceptional cases provided by law (e.g. during official inspections).
privacyPolicy.s4Text: For the website to function properly (e.g. saving items in your cart or authentication), we use browser storage (Cookies/Local Storage). This technology is necessary for the site to provide its services.
privacyPolicy.s5Text: You have the right to request the deletion or correction of your personal data at any time.
privacyPolicy.s5Note: Note: In the event of account deletion, information about completed orders (invoices) may be retained for internal accounting purposes.
